title: Priority Indicator Selection + Redundancy / Stability Review
selection_philosophy: Decision-dimension-driven. The purpose is to answer which grids planners should prioritize, not to reuse all predictive ML features.

Future Heat Severity.selection_rule: Use the sustained 2026-2030 mean predicted LST rather than a single endpoint or maximum year.

Trend Urgency.selection_rule: Use continuous relative heat-percentile Sen slope for spatial urgency within Kaduwela. Do not assign an arbitrary ordinal score to the descriptive trajectory classes.

Vegetation / Green Deficit.selection_rule: Use mean 2026-2030 (1 - green_mask): directly interpretable as persistent green-cover deficit and aligned with Step 29A.

Built-up / Urban Pressure.selection_rule: Use mean 2026-2030 NDBI: direct built-up intensity measure and the same intervention dimension manipulated in Step 29B.

Blue-space / Water Deficit.selection_rule: Use distance-to-water as direct spatial accessibility/proximity deficit. NDWI remains wetness evidence and is not interpreted as literal water-cover percentage.

Modeled Intervention Benefit.selection_rule: Use mean 2026-2030 cooling benefit from Step 29C's already-frozen PRIMARY scenario: +10pp green with MODERATE built-up reduction.

redundancy.within_dimension_use: Diagnostic support for choosing one representative and avoiding multiple same-concept criteria.
redundancy.cross_dimension_policy: Report high correlation but do not automatically delete a conceptually distinct planning dimension.

temporal_stability.method: Spearman correlation between selected 2026-2030 mean summary and each individual future year.

shap_policy: Future SHAP is supporting model-association evidence only; not a CRITIC/TOPSIS criterion and not an automatic selection score.
scenario_policy: Intervention benefit uses the already-frozen Step29C PRIMARY combined scenario (+10pp green, MODERATE built reduction). Values are model-based sensitivity, not causal guarantees.
uncertainty_policy: Step30 uncertainty remains a separate confidence/reference layer and is not included as a priority criterion.
